proposed_comments.body:
### Keep gh-aw-generated lock metadata and action pins in sync

**Severity:** `high`

The current head bumps `github/gh-aw-actions/setup` to v0.88.4 in `.github/workflows/issue-triage.lock.yml` but does not regenerate the associated metadata and action manifest. The generated file still declares `compiler_version: v0.87.10`, `GH_AW_INFO_CLI_VERSION: "v0.87.10"`, and the cached `github/gh-aw-actions/setup@bc8c008a419c5b7a29df6f5641edd35fd1c6ea85` manifest entry. That leaves a mixed gh-aw bundle and should be reverted or regenerated before merge.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The finding spans generated workflow metadata and manifest consistency rather than a single safe RIGHT-side diff range.
